story.iWant: the app to detect my first visit
story.soThat: I can be shown the setup wizard
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Create useFirstVisit hook (AC: 1, 2, 3) - 1.1 Create src/hooks/useFirstVisit.ts - 1.2 Check settingsStore.showWizard boolean on mount - 1.3 Return isFirstVisit boolean and markWizardCompleted() function - 1.4 Integrate with settingsStore for persistence - 1.5 Export hook from src/hooks/index.ts
- Task 2: Update settingsStore for wizard state (AC: 1, 2, 3) - 2.1 Add showWizard: boolean field to settingsStore (default: true) - 2.2 Add setShowWizard(value: boolean) action - 2.3 Ensure persistence via Zustand persist middleware - 2.4 Verify localStorage key: q-flash-settings
- Task 3: Add "Show Guide" button to Header (AC: 4) - 3.1 Open src/components/layout/Header.tsx - 3.2 Add "Show Guide" button with icon (HelpCircle from lucide-react) - 3.3 Wire button to settingsStore.setShowWizard(true) - 3.4 Position button in header navigation area (before language toggle) - 3.5 Add tooltip: "Show Setup Guide"
- Task 4: Create WizardModal placeholder component (AC: 2, 3, 4) - 4.1 Create src/components/features/wizard/WizardModal.tsx - 4.2 Use shadcn/ui Dialog component for modal - 4.3 Read settingsStore.showWizard to control open state - 4.4 Add placeholder content: "Wizard will be implemented in Story 3.2" - 4.5 Add "Don't show again" checkbox that calls settingsStore.setShowWizard(false) - 4.6 Add close button that calls settingsStore.setShowWizard(false)
- Task 5: Integrate WizardModal into App (AC: 2, 3, 4, 5) - 5.1 Import WizardModal in src/app/App.tsx - 5.2 Render WizardModal at app root level (outside routes) - 5.3 Verify wizard opens on first visit - 5.4 Verify wizard stays closed after dismissal - 5.5 Verify "Show Guide" button re-opens wizard
- Task 6: Add i18n translations (AC: 4) - 6.1 Add to src/i18n/translations/en.json - 6.2 Add Vietnamese translations to src/i18n/translations/vi.json
- Task 7: Testing and verification (AC: 1-5) - 7.1 Run npm run dev and verify no TypeScript errors - 7.2 Test: Clear localStorage → reload → verify wizard opens - 7.3 Test: Dismiss wizard → verify showWizard=false in localStorage - 7.4 Test: Reload → verify wizard stays closed - 7.5 Test: Click "Show Guide" button → verify wizard re-opens - 7.6 Test: Navigate between pages → verify wizard state persists - 7.7 Verify translations in both English and Vietnamese

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: When I visit the Tool page for the first time, a check is made against localStorage for wizard_completed flag AC2: If flag is false/missing, wizard should open automatically AC3: If flag is true, wizard does not open AC4: A "Show Guide" button in header re-opens wizard anytime AC5: First visit detection works across page navigation

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story defines first-visit detection mechanism using localStorage flag to trigger wizard modal. Part of Epic 3: Onboarding & Guide Experience.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: settingsStore manages user preferences with localStorage persistence using Zustand persist middleware. Pattern established in Story 1.3.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: First-time users must see a step-by-step wizard guiding them through prerequisites, device selection, and connection. Wizard can be re-opened anytime via header button.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Wizard modal uses shadcn/ui Dialog component with 5 steps. Each step has Next/Back/Skip buttons. Final step has "Don't show again" checkbox.

doc.title: Story 1.3: Zustand State Management Setup
doc.snippet: settingsStore created with language and persistence. Uses Zustand persist middleware with localStorage key 'qflash-settings'. Pattern to follow for adding showWizard field.

doc.title: Story 1.6: App Shell Layout Components
doc.snippet: Header component created with logo, navigation links, language toggle, and settings button. Located at src/components/layout/Header.tsx. Pattern to follow for adding "Show Guide" button.

story-context.constraints: - MUST use existing settingsStore pattern with persist middleware - MUST NOT modify core logic files in src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/ - MUST follow Hook Wrapper Pattern from architecture.md - MUST use shadcn/ui Dialog component for modal (already installed via @radix-ui/react-dialog) - MUST use HelpCircle icon from lucide-react for "Show Guide" button - MUST export new hook from src/hooks/index.ts for consistency - MUST follow i18n pattern: wizard.* namespace for all wizard-related keys - MUST place wizard components in src/components/features/wizard/ directory - WizardModal is PLACEHOLDER only - full wizard implementation in Story 3.2 - localStorage key MUST be 'qflash-settings' (already established in settingsStore) - showWizard field already exists in settingsStore - verify implementation only

tests.standards: Testing follows React best practices with TypeScript compilation checks. Manual testing required for localStorage persistence and UI interactions. Test cases defined in story AC column. No automated tests required for this story (testing epic not yet implemented).
tests.locations: - Manual testing via browser DevTools (localStorage inspection) - TypeScript compilation: npm run dev - Browser testing: http://localhost:5173
tests.ideas: - AC1: Test localStorage check on first visit (clear localStorage, reload, inspect console/network) - AC2: Test wizard auto-open (clear localStorage, reload, verify modal appears) - AC3: Test wizard stays closed (set showWizard=true in localStorage, reload, verify no modal) - AC4: Test "Show Guide" button (click button in header, verify modal opens) - AC5: Test persistence across navigation (dismiss wizard, navigate to /guide, back to /, verify stays closed) - Integration: Test "Don't show again" checkbox (check box, close modal, reload, verify stays closed) - Integration: Test close button (click close, verify modal closes and showWizard=false) - i18n: Test translations (toggle language, verify wizard text changes)
